title: Office shows a 'There's a problem with your license' warning
description: When I opened Excel this morning a license warning appeared and I can't save files.

worklogs.description: Determined in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center that no license was assigned to the user.
Assigned an Office365 E3 license, asked the user to Sign-out/Sign-in.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Your license has been assigned. In the Office applications, go to File > Account > Sign Out and then sign back in.

resolutionNote: License was unbound from the old device and a new license assigned to the user. After sign out/in, all Office applications are active.
